QuestInfo.name: Surl Knows All
QuestInfo.0: #b#p2450006##k told them about his first sighting of #p2450000# in #m325000000#. Maybe he would know more...
QuestInfo.1: #p2450006# saw #p2450000# entering town from the Rocky Road area, so the duo set off toward the portal in #b#m325000000##k to investigate the #b#MDmap325090310##k.
QuestInfo.2: The Shadow Knights had set up camp in the Rocky Mountains! Alpha and Beta defeated them, and uncovered a disturbing report. #p2450000# was nothing but an ordinary man, but the Shadow Knights brainwashed him into thinking he was a Goddess Teardrop, and gave him a small dose of time power!

0.0: I saw him when I was out for my nightly constitutional. He was dragging himself around in a big, dark robe like some kinda... zombie! I thought I was seeing a walking corpse!
0.1: I was just about to start spitting on him, and take after him with my cane, but I saw he was all dusty... Like he'd been up on the Rocky Road. I ain't a fool. I don't know what's out past #b#MDmap325090310##k, but I know it's too much fight for an old timer like me.
